decisions.reason: As an environmental sensor module that fits the firm's existing modular electronics platform and remained visible after launch, it is close to the firm's knowledge base and therefore more likely to be refined than withdrawn.

Because it explicitly replaces an earlier version, this voltage measurement module is part of an established product line where the firm has strong prior knowledge and clear learning feedback, making discontinuation unlikely.

A CAN bus interface builds directly on the firm's embedded communication and interface capabilities, so absorptive capacity is high and the product is likely to stay as a complementary module in the system.

The carbon dioxide sensor module is highly related to the firm's sensor expertise and modular architecture, and its continued dedicated presentation suggests enough value and learning potential to justify keeping it on the market.
